facebook.intro: Facebook calls this **Download your information**. It is part of the Meta Accounts Center.
steps: On facebook.com, open the menu under your profile picture and go to **Settings & privacy › Settings**.
Open **Accounts Center** and go to **Your information and permissions › Download your information**.
Choose **Download or transfer information** and select your **Facebook** profile.
Choose **All available information**, then **Download to device**.
Set **Date range** to **All time**, **Format** to **JSON** and **Media quality** to **High**.
Choose **Create files**.
facebook.ready: Facebook sends a notification and an email when the files are ready, which takes from a few hours to several days. Download every part from **Download your information**; the links stay valid for a few days.
facebook.extra_body: End-to-end encrypted chats are not in this export. Download them separately:
extra_steps: On messenger.com, choose your profile picture and go to **Privacy & safety › End-to-end encrypted chats › Message storage**.
Choose **Download secure storage data** and confirm with your password.
Keep the page open until the file **messages.zip** downloads. Add it together with the other files.

instagram.intro: Instagram uses **Download your information** in the Meta Accounts Center.
steps: On instagram.com, open **More › Settings**. In the app, open your profile and the menu.
Open **Accounts Center** and go to **Your information and permissions › Download your information**.
Choose **Download or transfer information** and select your **Instagram** profile.
Choose **All available information**, then **Download to device**.
Set **Date range** to **All time**, **Format** to **JSON** and **Media quality** to **High**.
Choose **Create files**.
instagram.ready: Instagram sends an email when the files are ready, usually within a day. Download every part from **Download your information**; the links stay valid for a few days.

x.intro: X calls this **Download an archive of your data**. It is only available on the website.
steps: On x.com, open **More › Settings and privacy**.
Go to **Your account › Download an archive of your data**.
Confirm your password and enter the code X sends you.
Choose **Request archive**.
x.ready: X sends a notification when the archive is ready, usually after a day or more. Go back to the same page and choose **Download archive**. Large archives come in several parts; download all of them.

snapchat.intro: Snapchat calls this **My Data**. Memories are only included when you turn them on.
steps: Go to **accounts.snapchat.com** and sign in.
Choose **My Data**.
Turn on **Export your Memories** and **Export JSON files**, and select every other category.
Set the date range to **All time**.
Confirm your email address and choose **Submit**.
snapchat.ready: Snapchat sends an email when the export is ready, which can take a day or longer. Use the link in the email or go back to **My Data › See exports**. Exports with many Memories come in several zip files; download all of them.
